name: Hushling (drift)
notes: Hushlings (story bible §8): child-sized figures of grey fog. Agent 0.3 m radius, 1.2 m tall. They do not walk: they drift a hand above the floor, modelled as flight capped at 1.5 m altitude, so they cross water, rubble and gaps silently but never rise to the rafters (a high ledge is still safe). Slow and eerie: 0.6 sneak, 1.0 drift, 2.5 m/s when they rush a sound, well below a running player; silence, not speed, is how you escape them. Fog seeps through crawlspaces and under gaps (squeezes) but cannot work a door handle.
